name: X-Man Tornado V4 3x3 (Flagship) - PiCube Special Edition
description: Introducing the X-Man Tornado V4 3x3 (Flagship) - PiCube Special Edition, a collectors’ dream collaboration between X-Man Designs and PiCube. This exclusive edition boasts fully transparent internals and is available only in limited quantities. Engineered for peak performance, it combines precision engineering with striking aesthetics to deliver a 3x3 that stands above the rest.
features: High-precision PC reinforced core ensures consistent wheelbase and uniform turning.
Integrated contact surfaces guarantee smooth, balanced, and efficient motion.
Full-bright color scheme enhances visibility and look-ahead for speedcubers demanding the best.
Magnetic dual-positioning system (core and corner-edge) for outstanding stability and explosive speed.
Durable, frosted exterior with a robust glossy finish, resistant to wear and scratches during even the most intense solves.
Special edition custom logo center cap and a magnetic storage box—portable, dust-proof, and shock-resistant.
